Major Fire Erupts Near Udyog Bhawan in Delhi, Slums Engulfed

A significant fire broke out near Udyog Bhawan in Delhi, rapidly spreading to nearby slums. The blaze reportedly started due to a short circuit in an electric panel. Emergency services, including approximately 20 fire tenders, were dispatched to the scene to control the fire and prevent further spread.
